user.title: Geely Smart Charge & Climate — observation only
user.description: Vehicle sensors are suggested automatically. The default charging rate is based on a standard 7 kW single-phase home charger. The system learns your vehicle's actual charging rate over time. If you know your charger's rate, you can enter it below. This development version only simulates charging.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one observation-only configuration is supported.
